Conversant Capital, an opportunistic real estate investment firm, has announced the final close of its inaugural private investment fund, Conversant Private Investment Fund (CPIF) with $845 million in equity capital commitments. This includes approximately $705 million in equity capital commitments raised for the commingled fund, exceeding its original target of $500 million by more than 40 percent, with the remainder raised for dedicated co-investment vehicles.

CPIF is backed by a diverse group of sophisticated global institutional investors, composed of both repeat and new Conversant partners, representing sovereign wealth funds, university endowments, foundations, healthcare institutions, pension plans, asset managers and family offices. With the Fund’s closing, Conversant now manages approximately $3.2 billion in assets.
